balls.text: a full toss which is low and angling across to end just outside off. Swung off the inside half of the bat to midwicket
belted over the bowler's head! He sits deep in the crease, and goes lofting at this length ball angling across and finishing around sixth stump
a yorker-length ball on the stumps, and driven to long-off's left

nabbed at extra cover! DC are striking late to check KKR. A slower ball this time from Ishant, who went short and pretty wide of off. Ramandeep went swatting far away from his body at what was a tenth-stump ball, but ended up getting the toe end of the bat to Shaw's left for a simple catch

scooped towards midwicket, and again I couldn't get how it went there. I thought there were two noises, the other off the helmet. Yup, the physio does come out. It was a full toss by Ishant wide of off, with Ramandeep getting across to scoop behind

wow, superb ball! An inswinging yorker at 144kph floors Russell - literally! It lands on the base of middle and leg, as Russell looks to jam his bat down with a horizontal bat, but is late. It is too quick for him, and he ends up on his stomach on the pitch

ahh, taken at mid-on! But what a typical Rinku innings: an impact cameo at the death to demoralise the opposition. Nortje went for a dipping yorker around fifth stump, as Rinku almost squatted to try and chip that back. But he couldn't it away this time, as Warner took it over his head
bam! Between extra cover and deep point! Short of a length - at a change of pace - just outside off, but Rinku is ready and waiting before swatting in the gap
blown away! That lands 59 rows back over long-off! He reaches out for this fullish ball, which is wide of off, and sends it flaying mercilessly with a horizontal bat
wide ball. Goes for the yorker around ninth stump, and is left alone
on the bounce to deep point's left. Nortje goes short and around sixth stump, as Rinku went hammering at it
unbelievable! Don't ask me how that went for six! He simply swatted at this full ball dipping around sixth stump, and casually bagged six wide of long-off
ohh, barely six! The man at wide-ish deep third chases to his right, and the ball just about beats him, with Rinku slicing at this full and wide ball outside off, even as he loses his bottom hand
full and a bit wide of off, as it is dragged to mid-off
now to deep third on two bounces, as the ball flies off his outside edge after he looks to swing at this length ball outside off
sharp pace at 136kph, and on a bouncer-length on sixth stump. He goes slashing, but is beaten
on a few bounces to deep point, who fumbles and allows the second. Russell went lofting at this length ball outside off, using all the force in his body
a high full toss almost in front of his face outside off, and slashed to deep point. No-ball called for height
ahh, another wide, but this seemed harsh. Yorker length and wide of off, while swinging away. Left alone by Rinku

taken at mid-off! Shreyas falls to the short ball. Khaleel bowled outside off, as the ball almost seemed to have rushed through to Shreyas, who went pulling but got it off the top edge. Stubbs kept his eyes on the skied ball, and took it reverse cupped
sliced to deep backward point! The ball lands very close to the rope, and is called six by the third umpire. Shreyas went opening the face of the bat at this full toss wide-ish of off, and creamed it
goes for a wide yorker outside off, as Russell reaches out and has a swish, but is beaten. Wide called, as they even pinch another run
a slower-ball yorker on off, and dug out to mid-off
uff, lovely sound off the bat! This goes over deep midwicket too, as Shreyas crushes this short ball around sixth stump, and clubs it for his first six
ahh, well bowled! He goes for the yorker while swinging it into middle and leg. Russell goes clipping but gets a leading edge to long-off

pumped over deep midwicket! It stays in the air for about 19 seconds, before landing beyond the fielder. Marsh bowls short again around off, but Russell kind of mis-hits it off the outside half of the bat
a bouncer ball, but called wide. Marsh goes on middle and off, and Russell ducks
top edge goes behind the wicket! Shorter side of a length outside off, as Russell has a pull at it, but the extra bounce takes the ball away
slower ball, and on a length and wide of off. Hacked to deep point
good short ball at 136kph. Bangs it in on off, and has Russell ducking
pulled on a few bounces to long-on, as Khaleel goes on the shorter side just outside off
yorker length, and angling into fifth stump. Squeezed to extra cover
ahh, a high-ish full toss around sixth stump, as Russell goes flashing but is beaten
on a full length, but quite wide of off. He lets it go, and it is called wide
no chance for deep point! He leapt there, but the ball flew over his hand. Full and wide from Khaleel, who goes outside off again, but now Russell is ready is muscling it over for six
now he attempts to slog across the line, but is beaten. Full around sixth stump from Khaleel, as he keeps angling them across
he is standing on off stump, so Khaleel goes full and wide of off while bowling a slower ball. Left alone, and wide called
slower ball on a full length around seventh stump, and biffed off the bottom of the bat to Shaw, who is close to mid-on
crashed to deep backward point! Salam went for a wide yorker outside off, but Russell reached out while standing deep in the crease, and sent it clatterring
Russelled over long-on! He gets a full toss around off, and bam it goes wide of long-on for another six
a dipping, low full toss on middle, and whipped to deep square leg

fuller side of a length in the channel outside off, as Shreyas looked to stab but missed. Salam thinks there was an edge, but Pant isn't convinced. Ohh, and the real-time replay hints there was a sound!
short of a length on fifth stump, and pulled to deep midwicket. The man at deep square, Sumit, runs and dives to his left all the way to keep this to two
ahh, this is quick at 147kph, as Nortje bowls on the shorter side of a length outside off. Russell went hacking but was beaten
bashed to deep extra cover! Hangs deep in the crease at this length ball, as he stands on leg. Russell then swats in the gap wide of mid-off
short ball at Shreyas right away at 140kph. This pitches on off and shapes back in, as Shreyas pulls on the bounce to fine leg
on the shorter side of a length, and angled in. Pitches just outside off and finishes close to off, as it is tapped to point

ramped to deep third! Ishant Sharma seemed to be at a straightish deep third, rather. Nortje went for the short ball around sixth stump, and the ball rose considerably. So Raghuvanshi went ramping while using the pace and bounce, but found the fielder on the edge of the boundary
full length angled into leg, and heading down, as he looked to clip but missed. Wide called

an effortless chip over mid-on, as he times it wonderfully. Warner there turns around and runs after the ball, with the man at deep midwicket pulling off from the rope at this left. Four given by the third umpire
between long-on and deep midwicket! Russell shows his muscle, as he hangs deep in the crease, and the ball is a low, dipping full toss just outside off. Swung across the line for four
now goes for a short ball to Russell, but it is called wide. The ball zoomed up off the short length outside off, as Russell let it go
shorter side of a length just outside off, and tapped to short third, who fumbles. Fifty off 25 balls for Raghuvanshi
very full and on fifth stump. Driven to extra cover

tickled to Pant! It was a soft dismissal. Narine falls to the bouncer. It pitched on off, and climbed on rather sharply towards Narine. He was standing after backing away, and looked to pull. But the extra bounce meant the ball took the top edge to the keeper, who took it with a reverse cup in front his face
this is a wide, though. The length is much fuller, but it pitches outside off and shapes away. Narine leaves it alone
bowls on a short of a length on off, with the ball angling away as Narine let it go
slower ball, on a full length on middle and off. Clipped after shifting his weight back for a single to deep square
pulled between long-on and deep midwicket, as he makes room at this short ball and goes attacking
guides this length ball angling in but straightening away to deep third
pretty full length outside leg, and heaved to fine leg off the inside half of the bat
pumped with a flat bat over mid-off! He stands outside leg, and swats this short-of-a-length ball finishing outside off after shaping away. Hard and flat six!
chips this full ball angling into middle and off for a single to deep midwicket
bowls a yorker just outside leg, and it is whopped hard wide of long-on
swung away over deep midwicket! He waits and lets the slower ball come to him, as it is again on a hittable length around off. Raghuvanshi goes across the line, and absolutely clubs it!
this is quick, and on the shorter side of a length just outside off. He went slashing, but is beaten
reverse swatted for six! Wow! He got into shape early, and got this length ball wide of off. The ball went off the higher side of the bat, but still got six
a low, dipping full toss, which is angling into the stumps. Swiped to deep midwicket
bowls a yorker, but too wide outside off even as Narine was hinting to get across. Wide called
good work by Marsh at extra cover, as he dives to his left to stop this. Raghuvanshi went driving aerially at this length ball outside off, but couldn't pierce the gap
on a length on fifth stump, as he went slashing, but got it off the bottom edge towards the bowler
ohh, wide not called! A bouncer on middle, and Narine let it go close to his head
flicks this aerially off a length on middle for a single to deep midwicket
on the shorter side of a length, as Marsh goes for a slower ball again. The ball pitches on middle, and is unconvincingly swung to long-on
full and on off at just 114kph, and gently clipped to deep midwicket
on the bounce to long-off! Again Marsh went for the slower ball, and this time went fuller and just outside off. Rammed down the ground by Narine
sliced over extra cover! Marsh slowed it down, and went for a length ball just outside off. Narine stands with his front leg out of the way, and lofts back for four more
bowls a bumper, but it is called wide. Goes for a bouncer on middle, and the ball angles away way too high. Narine lets it go
hacked between point and short third! He plays late at this short-of-a-length ball which is wide of off, and finds the gap to leave the fielders almost shocked
"My turn", says Raghuvanshi! He shuffled slightly across, and went hoicking at this length ball angling in and finishing on middle and off. Six over midwicket
change of pace, and on a length wide of off. Flashed to deep backward point for two
goes slashing at this shortish ball outside off, but finds the point fielder
gets across, and has a heave at this length ball wide of off, but gets it off the toe end towards point. Pant says acha hai, acha hai to Sumit
driven back aerially off a full length ball on off, and the ball goes off Sumit's right boot
crashed for six more! I am running out of verbs to describe Narine's methods. Axar went on a length around off, and Narine spotted that early to deposit it over deep square again

animated appeal for lbw by Axar and Pant, but turned down. No review taken by DC. Raghuvanshi went defending at this fullish ball just outside off, but this was drifting in. It hit his pad outside off, but the impact seemed outside off
goes lofting at this length ball wide of off, and this falls short of deep extra cover
swung away over deep square leg! Axar went on a full length on middle and off, and Narine went across the line for another big six
fuller and slower on off. Tucked towards deep midwicket

out of reach for Khaleel, and four! The batter went for the reverse sweep at this fullish ball angled in, and got it off the top edge, with Khaleel at short third turning back and chasing. He threw his hands out, but the ball fell wide
drives on the up to play wide of long-off, with the ball being on a length outside off
hacked to deep extra cover, with the ball being on a length and ending outside off after moving away
another length ball, but this angles into his pad. Whipped to deep midwicket

i think the ball fell just short of Nortje at long-off! Nope, it was dropped! He was leaning and dicing forward, with the ball dying on to him. Narine pummelled the ball off a length, as it finished outside off
on a length, and pretty wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
starts with a slower ball on a full length just outside off. Nudged to deep midwicket

fifty for Narine, as KKR pile up 88 in the powerplay! Incredible batting. He keeps backing away, and this time thumps this length ball around off over short third by opening the face of the bat a bit late
creamed between mid-off and extra cover! Another forecful shot, as he drives at this fullish ball finishing just outside off after angling away
slows it down to 106kph, and bowls on a full length while angling it across for it to end outside off. Tucked towards point off the toe end of the bat
deep into the crowd at deep midwicket! Again he stands with his front leg out of the way, and goes slamming at this length ball on the stumps, which bounces considerably too
slapped between cover-point and extra cover! The former fielder remained unmoved, as the ball went to his left, with Narine using all his power to slash at this length ball outside off
bowls a full ball on sixth stump, while angling it in, as Narine went lofting but missed, with the ball seaming away too
on the fuller side of a length on off, and dabbed to deep third. Excellent running gives them two
punched just beyond point! Superb timing! Just uses the pace of the ball - it is bowled at 142kph - as he opens the face of the bat a bit, and just guides this back-of-a-length ball in the channel
four first ball! Fine leg is inside the circle, and he went pulling at this shortish ball angling in and finishing on middle and leg. Good swivel too from Raghuvanshi

now taken by Stubbs at mid-off! So Salt's luck doesn't last long. He stands deep in the crease, and a bit outside leg, looking to loft at this pretty full ball angling into the stumps. I think he was done in by the rapid pace there, with the ball seemingly skidding through.

dropped by Warner! He had to come in quite a few steps forward from deep backward square leg, only for the ball to pop off his hands. Salt went pulling at this short-of-a-length ball on middle, but seemed to have got it off the top half of the bat
this is on a length at 141kph, as it lands on off while shaping into middle. Dabbed towards cover

more fortune for Narine! This time the leading edge takes it over short third. He went slogging across the line at this length ball angled in, but seemed to have closed the face of the bat too early. KKR flying their way so far!
sliced over extra cover! Pant looks perplexed. Narine opens the face of the bat at this length ball outside off, and sends it caressing for another six

ohh, beaten this time! On a length on the stumps, and angled in, as Narine went swinging across the line but saw the ball go over the stumps. Marsh seemed to suggest that there was a noise, but Pant ran out of time when he finally signalled

ahh, some luck for Narine now! His bottom hand is off as he throws his hands at this yorker-length ball around sixth stump, and it turns out to be a low full toss. The ball finds its way between short third and point
crunched over deep square! Fantastic sound off the bat. Ishant went for the short delivery this time, as Narine stood after backing away and pulled hard and far for another six

biffed over mid-off! Narine even holds the pose after the free swing of the bat. Ishant slowed it down to 122kph, and bowled on a length while angling it into the stumps. But Narine had his front leg out, and sent that sailing
between mid-off and extra cover! He stands deep in the crease this time, and though there is hardly any foot movement, still manages to drive at this length ball moving away towards outside off
ahh, beaten this time! On the shorter side of a length on middle and off, as Salt went pulling but saw the ball move away and go past his bat
drilled over cover! Khaleel bowls on a length, while angling it across and ending it wide of off. Salt waits before going over cover for four more
this is quite full and on the stumps, with Narine driving to mid-off with his front leg out of the way
creamed to deep point! He has a forceful hack at this shortish ball outside off, with Narine getting enough room to attack that too

chipped over the bowler's head, and Stubbs does well chasing from mid-on and pulling it back last moment. The ball was bowled into the pitch by Khaleel, and Narine went with a vertical bat back down the ground
slashed wide of short third! Salt flashes at this length ball, which is wide of off, and plays late to beat short third to his right for four more. Good over for KKR
not quite a convincing loft, but he still gets four over cover. The bat turned in his hands as he went lofting this length ball in the channel, which shapes back in and ends closer to off
ahh, he puts bat on ball pretty late there. Narine had backed away early, and Ishant went for a yorker on fourth stump. Narine dragged it to deep third after making room
and again! This time Ishant gets good bounce off a shortish length outside off, with Narine looking to pull but missing
bowls on a length on fourth stump while angling it in, but the ball moves away after pitching. Narine goes lofting, but is beaten on the outside edge

ahh, good movement back in off the pitch. He bowls on the shorter side of a length just outside off, but the ball finishes on middle and hits Salt's back thigh as he looked to hack. The ball trickles away, and they pinch a leg bye
on a length just outside off, and Narine can only pull on the bounce to midwicket
ahh, this is good bowling! It swings in on a yorker length on fourth stump, with Narine looking loft after backing away, but getting beaten
Narine stands outside leg, and Khaleel goes quite full, and a bit wide, outside off. Left alone

wow, Pant ends in front of first slip, and can't hang on as he dives to his right. Khaleel bowled shortish and outside off, with the ball shaping away to end pretty wide, with Salt missing his attempted slash. Wide called again
flashed on the bounce to cover-point! Shorter side of a length on off, and Salt hangs back while looking to cut forcefully
length ball shaping back in towards middle and leg, and pushed down
same ball, as he goes on the shorter side of a length around off while moving it away. Looks to hack, but is beaten. Wide given

dropped by Pant! It is called byes, with the umpire saying no bat involved. It wasn't easy to take for Pant either, as he leapt up full stretch, with the ball flying off the top edge. The ball took the gloves and went off, as Salt went slashing at this back-of-a-length ball outside off, which was angling across
length ball around off. Pulled but without much power, and taken by Shreyas on the leg side inside the circle! KKR win by 106 runs
fullish ball on off. Cutter from Russell. Nortje tries to hit it over midwicket but misses. Ball hoops over the stumps
slower ball bouncer on off. Nortje hangs back before hitting a tennis-style smash over his head. Mistimed but gets it over Vaibhav
short and wide. Nortje cuts it over short third. Narine runs around the boundary line from deep backward point, and manages to stop a four
short ball around off. Tries to pull but only finds air this time
short ball angling into his body, and hits Ishant's on the handle of the bat as he tries to take evasive action
yorker length ball on off. Gets his toes out of the way before slapping a shot to the off side
back of a length ball around off stump. Backs away to play it to the off side but can't get bat on ball
And Vaibhav gets a third! Goes for the tried-and-tested method of bouncer to a lower-order batter. Gets a shoulder-high ball to Rasikh outside off and he slices the pull to the wicketkeeper
good length ball on middle, and hit straight for a single
full ball outside off and driven to cover
full on middle and he gets low to sweep. Gloved onto his pad, before dribbling away to the leg side
full ball just outside off. Driven square to deep point for a single
full ball on middle. Turning in and hits his front leg and he misses the straight drive. Turn meant it would miss leg stump so no appeal for lbw

To deep midwicket! Full ball on off and middle. Turning into Sumit. With only tailenders remaining, he goes for a big shot over the leg side, but does not have the distance on this occasion either. Time out
length ball around off and goes straight through. Salam misses the defense and the LBW appeal is turned down. KKR do not have a review

Stubbs' innings is over as he can't clear Starc at deep backward square leg. Varun bowls a quicker one that lands outside leg, and Stubbs doesn't get enough room for his hands to go through the bat swing. Taken well inside the boundary line
full ball outside off and Stubbs plants his front leg right in front before swatting a drive over cover. Super followthrough on that shot, finishing with the bat behind his head
a quick ball darted into his toes, and Stubbs can't put the free-hit away
wild ball! Varun comes around the stumps and bowls an overpitched ball that angles across the right-hander and lands outside the pitch. Salt tries to dive to his right and stop it, but futile
length ball angling into leg stump. Sumit tries to flick it off his hips but misses. Leg bye towards short fine leg
overpitched ball around off and he toe-ends a shot to long on for a single. Gets to fifty in 28 balls

Narine gets hit for his third six of the over! Narine errs by bowling a half-tracker on off, which is also turning in, and Sumit needs no second invitation. Hangs back and muscles a strong pull over deep square leg
full ball, drifting and landing just outside off. Sharp turn into Sumit as he mistimes a defensive shot to the leg side
Narine bowls flat and full, in fact it is a yorker. Stubbs does well to bring the bat down and dig it out
another one! Full ball on middle and leg. Turning into Stubbs, and he launches one over deep midwicket! That has gone 70m
good length ball outside off. Stubbs stands tall, shuffles backwards, and then pummels a shot away from his body, and gets it over cover!
full ball just outside off. Stubbs clears the front leg and wants to hit it over cow corner. But loses his shape, and hits the toe of the bat.
half-tracker wider outside off but he can't put it away. Cut square to Rinku on the boundary line
full ball just outside off. Sumit's eyes light up and he clatters a shot very hard, back past Varun to long off. Flew off the bat

loud appeal for lbw, but not given. Shreyas chats with Varun before reviewing. 50-50 shout from KKR's reactions. This was a full ball landing around middle and hitting his pad with the batter pressing forward. Turning way down leg, another review wasted.
comes over the wicket to the right-hander. Good length ball on middle, but turns down the leg side

Manish Pandey joins the action now! Runs in from long on and takes a catch inside the circle that was swirling by diving forward. Varun enticed Axar with a tossed up ball just outside off and he went for the glory shot. Mistimed, very high in the air, and there was little doubt on Pandey's catching technique

this time Shreyas holds onto a catch off Varun's bowling! Tossed up ball, a bit wider outside off. Turning away and Pant also tries to go inside out over cover. Throws all his energy behind it but the shot is sliced and Shreyas at cover calls for that nice and early
around the stumps to Stubbs. Full ball outside leg stump and Stubbs slog sweeps to the fielder at deep midwicket
A 28-run over! Another low full toss outside off, near the tram-lines. Pant reaches out and swings the bat in a such a way that it flies off the face of the blade to race away to point for four more

a 23-ball fifty for Rishabh Pant! That would make fans of Indian cricket so happy! Fullish ball just outside off. Pant gets low before swinging across the line, and sends it behind square leg for four. Terrific innings
around the stumps, and that does not change the result much. Low full toss outside off stump and Pant slices a shot away from his body, sending it behind point. Pant on 47*

gem of an innings! Venkatesh comes over the wicket now, but the result is the same. Rishabh goes very low and then plays a shot with the bat-speed of a flick but the gentleness of a scoop. Dropkicked over fine leg!
up and over cover! Good length ball around off and Pant uses the bottom hand to not only drive but drive it in such a way that the shot is lofted over wide long off
just clears short fine leg! Short of length ball angling into his body. Pant plays his trademark hook over short fine leg while his head falls over. Not the best execution, but enough!

full ball landing just outside leg. Stubbs makes room by backing away and then absolutely hammers a shot straight past the non-striker. Russell runs around from long on and gets there in time, or so it appears. When the camera pans to him, we see Russell picking himself up and the ball resting on the boundary skirting
full ball on his toes and Pant clips it away to deep backward square leg, where there is protection
overpitched ball around leg and Stubbs toe-ends a shot to long on for a single
misses his line there. Half-tracker of sorts, landing outside the wide line outside off. Salt does well to move swiftly and stop that
full ball, quite wider outside off stump. Slapped past Varun after reaching out, and sent to long off
good length ball on middle. Hurries onto Stubbs while also getting big on him. Flat-bats a ball uncomfortably to Russell at long on
good length ball from around the stumps. Pant flicks it off the back foot to deep midwicket
full ball just outside off. Stubbs goes deep in his crease before flat-batting a dragged shot to wide long on. Venkatesh Iyer with some work on the boundary line to stop that strong shot
Pant uses his feet but Narine bowls a short-ish ball outside leg. Pant ends up in an awkward position  and ends up bunting a shot to the leg side for one
full ball just outside off. Pant mistimes a cut with the ball turning away. Stopped at point

full ball on off. Gets low for the sweep. Misses it, and it hits his helmet before going to short third. No LBW appeal because the turn would've taken the ball past off stump anyway. The team doctor runs out to check for concussion
good length ball on middle and off. Too close to his body for the cut but he attempts anyway. Gloved past the keeper
full ball just outside off. Bit of turn in. Driven confidently to mid off
full ball outside off. Pant gets in position to play a reverse swipe, but the ball hits his arm and goes to the leg side
around the stumps to Pant. Fullish ball on off. Comes down the track and blocked to the off side

Chakravarthy can have the last laugh, but dropped by Shreyas at deep midwicket! Stubbs tries to stay aggressive again, and pulls this cramping delivery too square. Shreyas got his body behind that, but the ball popped out!
high and clears long on! Good length ball around off. Stubbs stays in his crease and flat-bats a shot over the bowler
fullish ball on middle, and turning into leg again. This time cramps Stubbs up as he backs away too. Punched to the bowler
Chakravarthy gets a rude welcome! Full ball on middle. Turning into leg. Stubbs stays leg side of the ball, clears the front leg and hammers a shot over deep midwicket
terrific ball. Fullish on middle and off but gets some extra bounce. Pant tries to cut but he's surprised by extra spice off the pitch. Inside edged onto his body, and very nearly onto the stumps
good length ball on leg. Turning towards middle. Pant stays on the back foot and drags a grounded pull to cow corner
fullish ball on middle and leg. Stubbs gets low to play the reverse sweep. Misses the connection but it hits his body before rolling away behind the keeper
full ball outside off. Pant goes across and drags a sweep to deep backward square leg
good length ball on off. Narine stays on the back foot and works it with the turn to the leg side
full ball on middle. Defended with the full face of the bat
short ball again. Around middle and off. Pant sways away from the ball's line and lets this one go

third six in five balls! Russell tries to deliver a short ball to counter the previous six but Pant was almost expecting it. Pulls, and it is not perfect, but enough on this small ground to beat deep square leg again

Pant looking in exquisite touch - his second six in four balls! Full ball on middle and leg. Pant doesn't use his feet much, and relies on his hand-eye co-ordination to swipe a six over deep square leg
good length ball around off again. Pace off delivery this time and Stubbs guides it towards deep third for one
good length ball on a fourth-stump line. Carefully blocked towards point, off the back foot
full ball outside off and he clatters a drive to deep cover
full ball on middle, and Pant flicks to deep square leg. Powerplay done there with KKR using only two bowlers in the first six
short ball around leg and Pant doesn't even bother ducking because it's bouncing so much.  Wide given. Team fifty
short ball just outside off. Mows a mistimed pull to the right of midwicket for a single
yorker attempted, very nearly successful. Dug out by Stubbs
lucky for Stubbs that beats short fine leg. Vaibhav digs it in, and Stubbs comes down the ground before bringing out the pull. Absolutely mistimed but fortune favours him there

punchy shot off the back foot and he gets it past point to the backward point four! Excellent shot, waiting on that length ball outside off, and he also had to counter a bit of swing in while playing the shot
short ball just outside off. Stubbs pull from almost head high. Mistimed to mid on
beautiful from Pant! Full ball swinging in but landing outside leg. Pant uses his wrists to flick it languidly off his heel and sends it behind square leg
full ball just outside off. Gets low and plays a straight drive, but mistimed. Past the non-striker to mid off
short of good length ball on leg stump. Right-hander Stubbs knocks it off his body to the  leg side

chopped on! Starc gets the second Aussie too. Good length ball on a fifth-stump line. Warner doesn't have the width to cut but goes for it anyway. Under-edge onto the deck and into the stumps. Replay shows Starc changed his pace on the wicket ball
clubbed away! Home run from Warner. Full ball on off. Warner clears the front leg and clobbers Starc over cow corner.
short of good length around off stump. Warner taps it towards point after riding the bounce

short ball too good for Porel! Simple catch for short fine leg. Arora aims for a short ball at Porel's head, and he tries the pull while taking his eyes of the ball. Knocks the youngster over with a classic tall fast bowler's dismissal
full ball on off and Porel tries to hammer it back past the bowler but Vaibhav gets low to scoop the ball up on the followthrough!
full ball around leg and middle stump. Porel assumes the ball with angle across so offers the full face of the bat to drive. Hit to mid off
full ball just outside leg. Flicked off his shin, but straight to midwicket. Fielder throws the stumps down but the batter was inside his crease
fullish ball around off. Warner backs away before stretching out, getting some bat on that to send it to deep third
good length ball originates on leg stump but swings across the left-hander with the seam that's directed towards first slip. To the keeper
good length ball just outside off. Porel pokes at it, but the ball moves away after pitching, and whizzes past his outside edge

Mitchell gets Mitchell! And that is Starc's first IPL 2024 wicket. Marsh looks to drive this full ball from his body and generates a lot of power on that shot, but not the height, and Ramandeep at cover point intuitively sticks both hands out at the right time. Marsh's poor form continues
full ball around off stump and Warner offers the full face of the bat to push it back past the bowler
full ball around off stump. Warner taps it from inside his crease to cover's left
full ball outside off. Bit of movement away and Warner gets low to clatter a cover drive. Misses, and through to Salt
full ball around leg. Warner tries to flick but it tickles his pad, and Salt can't stop it on the dive either! Races down to fine leg for four
back of a length ball outside off. Gets somewhat big on Marsh but he manages to play a cut towards point

can mid-on get there - yes! Varun Chakravarthy, not particularly known for his fielding, has taken a sensational low catch diving forward. Vaibhav bowls a fullish ball outside off, and the ball swings into Shaw. He tries mow it over mid-on, but mis-hits. The ball doesn't gather a lot of air, so Varun has to take the tough route of diving forward. Mission possible! They go to the TV umpire who confirms it is a clean catch.

appeal for lbw! Only Vaibhav is interested. Not given Are KKR reviewing? Yes. Height could be a factor here. This was a length ball that moved in sharply after pitching, and hit Shaw after he fended down the wrong line. Too high. Review lost by KKR.
full ball originating on a leg-stump line but swinging in and landing on middle. Gently tucked off his pads to the on side for a single
full ball outside off. Warner backs away, and ends up backing away too much. Can't meet the ball after reaching out
hurried onto Warner but Warner will get four nonetheless. Short ball, aimed at Warner's body. He tries to pull but ends up top-edging it over Narine at short fine leg. One-bounce four
wrong line, and Warner punishes Vaibhav. Short ball, landing outside leg, and Warner swivels before swinging the bat and putting the loose ball away to fine leg for four
put away, over cover point! Starc errs by giving Shaw width in a length ball. Shaw pummels a smart short, almost lifting it over the infield for four
smartly played over the cordon! Beats deep third too. Starc bends his back and goes short. Shaw lets the ball get across before playing a slash with the bat's face open. Races to the fence
full ball on middle, and a bit of swing into his pads but Shaw uses his wrists to flick it strongly through midwicket. Timing not perfect, but atleast it is in the gap
fullish ball just outside off. Prods forward and fends it to the off side. Don't see swing so far
length ball around off and he plays a tentative cut to the off side
short ball just outside off. Warner jumps and guides a shot to deep third, one of two outfielders on the boundary line
